user.title: AwoX Connect lamp
user.description: Pick the lamp. Only Telink/AwoX Connect lamps (manufacturer id 0x0160) seen by a connectable adapter or ESPHome proxy are listed.

credentials.title: Mesh credentials
credentials.description:
Lamp {address}, seen via {via} at RSSI {rssi} dBm.

Enter the mesh name and password (the same values as `mesh_name` / `mesh_password` in the ESPHome hub YAML). The lamp accepts only one BLE connection: switch off the ESPHome hub and close the AwoX/EGLO app before testing.

data.keep_connected: Keep connected (instant state updates, uses 1 proxy slot)

error.not_found: The lamp is not visible to any connectable Bluetooth adapter/proxy right now.
error.invalid_auth: The lamp rejected the mesh name/password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Is another device (ESPHome hub, app) still connected to the lamp? See the log for details.

abort.no_devices_found: No AwoX Connect lamp found via Home Assistant Bluetooth.
abort.unpaired: Factory-reset device ("unpaired") - not part of a mesh, ignored.
